originality.rationale: The key exact content is a specialization of Laurent–Nogueira's explicit rational plateaux and cycles, not just a qualitative analogy to period adding. The fixed geometry and diagonal invariant setup already occur in Proskurnikov–Zabarianska's Example 1. Their special radius produces period two; using their same three distance formulae at a variable radius identifies the two-branch map to which the exact plateau theorem applies. Lowering the anchor radii simply preserves their self-neighbor property. No independent scientific remainder was established in the phase formulas or fiber multiplier, which are affine itinerary and slope calculations on those same branches.
residual_risks: There may be a separately published direct HK derivation; the rejection does not require one. The source comparisons here make no claim about equality-case cycles, where conventions can differ.
